items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That's Sonny Redd. ... you know how many times he did the two horned things with Art Farmer in his career?

ctx.x: I mean, half of that… The double set is a re-issue of "The Imagination.” The other part is your first recording with them.

See, I'd like to spend a little time doing this again. That's Sonny Redd. Did you know, out of all the indifferences we had with Benny and myself, you know how many times he did the two horned things with Art Farmer in his career?
You told me they never did it
